title: GO Track IoT ERP System
seoTitle: GO Track IoT ERP System Project | 2M Designers
description: A client-specific web ERP dashboard for GO Track IoT, connecting projects, finance, sales, inventory, CRM, roles and day-to-day activity.
headline: One operational view across projects, finance, sales and inventory
summary: A client-specific ERP workspace designed to give GO Track IoT a clear view of business performance while keeping its operational modules in one secure web system.
overview: The dashboard brings project activity, orders, customers and commercial targets into one executive overview. Financial, sales, inventory and CRM views sit inside the same interface, reducing the need to move between disconnected tools.

The wider navigation shown in the delivered system covers company structure, users and roles, accounts, purchasing, inventory, operations and customer service. Light and dark interfaces support different working preferences without changing the information architecture.

highlights.title: Executive dashboard
highlights.copy: Project, order, customer and revenue-target indicators are presented together for a fast operational read.

highlights.title: Finance and sales visibility
highlights.copy: Revenue, profit, cash flow, total sales and monthly-target progress are available from the main workspace.

highlights.title: Inventory and customer signals
highlights.copy: Low-stock, turnover, satisfaction and lead indicators help teams spot items that need attention.

highlights.title: Operational activity stream
highlights.copy: Sales, receipts, inventory orders, project completion and customer registration appear in one recent-activity view.

highlights.title: Structured access
highlights.copy: Company, branch, department, designation, user and role controls support a structured multi-team setup.

highlights.title: Light and dark themes
highlights.copy: The same dashboard is available in two visual modes for different environments and user preferences.

title: SASPAK Cargo ERP System
seoTitle: SASPAK Cargo ERP System Project | 2M Designers
description: A cargo ERP implementation for SASPAK Cargo with controlled account posting, GL voucher creation, document locking and multimodal workflow context.
headline: Controlled financial posting built around cargo operations
summary: A client-specific cargo ERP implementation that connects document posting with job, party and transport-mode context across sea, air and land operations.
overview: The account-posting workspace is designed for sale invoices, purchase invoices, receipts and payments. Users can load unposted documents by type and date, review selected records and amounts, then post them through a controlled workflow.

Posting creates general-ledger voucher details and locks the source document, helping preserve the relationship between operational records and accounts. Job, party, amount, status and reference fields keep each document traceable from one screen.

highlights.title: Controlled account posting
highlights.copy: Sale invoices, purchase invoices, receipts and payments move through a clear load, select and post workflow.

highlights.title: GL voucher creation
highlights.copy: Posting creates general-ledger voucher details and locks the source document to protect workflow integrity.

highlights.title: Document-level visibility
highlights.copy: Document number, date, job, party, amount, status and reference number remain visible in the working table.

highlights.title: Selection summaries
highlights.copy: Loaded records, selected records, selected PKR amount and the current mode are summarised before action.

highlights.title: Cargo operating context
highlights.copy: Sea, air and land navigation keeps the ERP aligned with the modes used by the cargo business.

highlights.title: Connected master data
highlights.copy: Company, customer, job order, contract, party and location setup support the posting workflow around it.
